blockingFindings.description: V211's extended body-surface support now covers the gray thigh areas almost to both knees in sit and crouch. The separate shorts-like edges do not join into the lilac overskirt hem: the outer hem still folds beside and behind the knees and leaves the center of the lap without a continuous edge. Keep the longer support layer and carry a shaped front panel from the waist across both thighs while retaining one connected outer hem.

The prone render still stacks several folds beneath the hips. Both standing profiles retain a stepped front outline between the hip and hem. Shape and inspect the front transition after the lap-spanning panel is added.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
